notes.title: UFHO2 is now free!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

After two years since launch, I've decided to put UFHO2 completely free! No in-app purchases, no ads.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8814610/0e5ff3bd1aad59ebc8bfc5c19446c1b5eb06d268.jpg[/img]

The reason? Well, after the game got out of most charts, it's not selling too much any more, so by setting it free at least people will find it again and play it.

If you're into playing on the go, search for the game on the App Store or Google Play, and download it on your phone/tablet (for free too). Just one thing: it's meant to be played on a big screen, so better tablets or phones that are 5" and up.
iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/ufho2-a-space-strategy-game/id840938380?mt=8
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tinycolossus.ufho2

Note: by downloading the game here on Steam you should also receive the two DLCs included.

Enjoy!

[url=www.twitter.com/CiroContns][b]Ciro[/b][/url]

notes.title: UFHO2 is live!
notes.notes:
The game is finally live! Yay!!!

Enjoy a 10% launch discount for a week, to celebrate the launch.

Additionally, I made available [b]2 DLCs[/b]: the Soundtrack by Francesco D'Andrea (which includes some nice bonus tracks), and the Extras, a collection of work in progress images, screenshots, videos and audio, which will give you an insight into the production of UFHO2 (priced at a mere 99 cents! :D).

You can get the 2 DLCs separately or buy the [b]Deluxe Edition[/b], which contains the base game + Soundtrack + Extras. The Deluxe Edition too will be 10% off for a week.

Now, let's celebrate by playing some UFHO2!!

- Ciro

notes.title: UFHO2 is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, Ciro here (aka the developer :D)!
I'm completing the last operations to bring UFHO2 to Steam, just hold a little bit more!

The game has been submitted to Valve for final approval, and I'm creating the final assets (I'm on the Collectible Cards right now).

Just another 10 days more or less while we test the Steam version, and the game will be live! In the meanwhile, I enabled the community so you can upload art or other minor things before the game goes live, if you want :)

Hurray!
